title: Chapter 644
paragraphs: Chapter 644
Episode 164. The Land of the Evil Spirit (6)
Although she managed to avoid a fatal blow, Talaris' condition was not good.
She had internal injuries, and the breath she exhaled was tinged with blood.
The fighting spirit of the martial artist who challenged Cirone the most - if it weren't for that, Talaris would already have been torn apart in madness.
"The main enemy of Runecandle is attacking the Sword Garden, but you left it to come to Lady Talaris. I didn't know you hated me so much."
The chaotic energy that was protecting the Sword Garden, Calron, and Lam weakened.
All that chaotic energy was absorbed by Rosa.
In other words, it had all become Rosa's personal power.
Jin was reminded of the nightmare of the Sword Emperor War from the massive chaotic energy she exuded.
Rosa narrowed her eyes as if amused by Jin's words.
[Wouldn't you have done the same?]
Rosa Runecandle would definitely try to deal with Lady Talaris before me.
The moment he felt Talaris's chill faintly for the first time, Jin had thought so immediately.
In retrospect, there was no reason for him to be so sure.
Without a doubt, it would be far more efficient for Rosa to continue to suppress Zifl and Kinzelo's massive forces than to deal with Talaris alone.
After the chaotic energy of Lam and the city had weakened, the bombardment of each force more easily penetrated the airspace of the Sword Garden than before.
When Jin did not respond, Rosa smiled.
[You may not like to admit it, but you're a lot like me.]
Boom-!
A loud sound rang out from the God-killing Bow.
Rosa casually deflected Kaio's arrow.
Though his energy had dropped due to the long-range support, the power wasn't something even the pre-fatigue Jin could easily handle.
"What do you mean we're alike? Don't equate the Thirteen Battle Kings of the noble Myungwang race with a monster like you."

[Myungwang race, it's my first time seeing one in person. But the first impression is disappointing. The fact that you're provoking me because you want to save that child... The Myungwang Sword that the youngest often showed me didn't give off such a cowardly feeling.]
"Relying on power obtained through decadence, is that why you are so arrogant?"
[Decadence... I've never been wary of such ambiguous human standards, even before I became Chaos.]
Creak-!
Suddenly, a blade of black light swept across Kaio's back. Had Kaio reacted slower, he would have been cleaved in half.
Rosa didn't move. The blade that threatened Kaio was born from the chaos beneath his feet, following Rosa's will.
Before anyone knew it, dozens of such swords had been formed. They left a shining trace, mercilessly slashing through the light pillars of the God-killing Bow.
Even before the afterimage vanished, the black blades swirled, focusing on Jin, Kaio, and Talaris.
"Brother Jin! Don't mind me and save your comrade!"
Kaio shouted as he repelled the chaotic swords with a barrage of mountain-killing attacks.
Jin couldn't even afford to reply. The frost protection shields opened by Talaris and Mott, in response to the attack, were collapsing too quickly.
On the other hand, Rosa's swords increased in number every time he blinked. One hundred, two hundred, three hundred... Rosa first moved when Jin charged at Talaris.

[The value of a family lies in its moral degradation, not in decadence or depravity. You often said that. I have pondered about it, but no matter how hard I tried, I couldn't understand the difference.]
Jin, blocked by the madness, took a step back.
[Runecandle has killed countless people and reveled in conquest and plunder. To someone, this is decadence. What is your standard?]
Jin didn't hesitate with his answer.
"I'm a human born in Swordga and the successor of the Demon Sword, not a puppet of chaos. Just that."
[That's a good answer.]
As he took a step back, Jin parried the madness.
The power he felt from Rosa in just one exchange clearly surpassed his own.
It would have been the same even if he hadn't accumulated fatigue and injuries from the previous battle.
Moreover, he felt an energy piercing his body along the clashing swords.
'Like poison, the chaos invades the body...!'
Chaos, a dark force that drags humans into demonhood.
Rosa is a vast chaos itself and the most powerful source of infection. Ordinary warriors would be eroded by chaos just by standing near her.
Maybe even warriors above 9 stars couldn't handle it, and even superhumans might not be able to engage in prolonged direct combat with her. Or rather, he was certain.
The God-killing Blood and the Mad Heart were frantically pushing back the chaos transmitted from Rosa.
'This didn't happen when we first met in the Sword Garden... Was it the result of her receiving something from the prophet after our conversation went wrong, or was she hiding it?'
Either way, what Rosa's infectiousness meant was one thing.
At the moment, the only human who could fight Rosa in the world was Jin.
[So it was true that the Myungwang race is immune to chaos, as Illyina said. Then you too have transcended humanity.]
"You seem to insist on placing us on the same line, why? Do you want some false consolation that you're not the only one who has crossed the line?"
[You'll understand when you have a child, a satisfying child. How much joy it brings when such a child resembles me. I am just that.]
"You're completely mad. I wish you wouldn't lump us together, considering you've succumbed to chaos."
[When you have a child, a satisfying child, you will understand. The joy of having such a child resemble me. I am merely that.]
"You're completely mad. I'd appreciate it if you don't lump us together considering you've succumbed to chaos."
["Hmm, if that was the case, Runcandel would have been finished before you arrived. It seems you continue to misunderstand this mother about that part."]
Madness, or demon nature.
Although she was called crazy, Rosa was different from Ron, who was on the brink of defying destiny, and Smarion, the Songbird of the Twisted Pass.
She should have lost her sanity long ago after accepting so much chaos, but Jin didn't feel any hint of that from Rosa.
Rather, Rosa felt more 'alive' than ever before.
In Jin's memory, the agent of the family rarely showed emotion, especially joy or satisfaction.
But now, Rosa seemed genuinely happy.
She also seemed sad. About having to kill her beloved child with her own hands.
Jin's gaze reached behind Rosa. Talares and Mot were barely holding up amidst the chaos of the blades.
"Do you want to save the Lady of the Secret Garden? Well, you must have considered her more of a mother than I did."]
The blade of madness dug into Jin's chest. Barely fending it off with Bradamante, Jin lost his balance and was thrown backward.
I'm jealous.....
Rosa, who said that, ignored Jin trying to prevent a follow-up attack, turned around, and looked at Talares.
For a moment, thoughts about Talares boiled up in Rosa's mind. In retrospect, she felt like she had always been jealous of the Lady of the Secret Garden, not just now.
Siron was always closer to her than Rosa was.
[What if I take the life of the Lady of the Secret Garden with the sword that my first child saved you with? Would that hurt you a bit?]
Meteor shower.
The third battle gear of Runcandel and the sword of her first kin that saved Jin. The raised madness was calling for a dark meteor.
The power surpassing Luna's heart sword Red Moon, which wiped out the island that day, shook the whole battlefield even before striking the ground.
But the dark meteor was tied up in the sky for a while, unable to fall, as if caught in a trap.
Soul Sword Ultimate Skill, First Form
The First Night
Sense isolation, the first sign of the Soul Sword Ultimate Skill.
For a moment, Rosa's senses shut down.
But even before three seconds passed.
Rosa regained all of her lost senses and started controlling the meteor shower again. The soul energy of the First Night that was holding onto the Meteor Shower was being disturbed.
Then, a contest of strength began between Jin and Rosa. The soul energy of the First Night and the chaotic energy of the Meteor Shower were pushing each other.
[Is this the best sword you have mastered so far?]
Thousands of dark blades that seemed to have swallowed up the entire battlefield stopped moving. It was the result of Rosa focusing entirely on the Meteor Shower.
Thanks to that, Kaio, Talares, and Mot had a moment to catch their breath.
However, they could not move. The blades that stopped moving blocked them like bars of a prison.
Kaio had enough strength left to try to break it, but Talares did not.
Mot tried to teleport shortly, but the chaos energy blocking the interdimensional gate of another world was too strong.
It felt like time had stopped on the battlefield. The Meteor Shower and the First Night were moving little by little, only noticeable upon close inspection.
Jin's ultimate technique was being pushed back. The layered curtain of soul energy was silently being torn apart by the Meteor Shower.
Rosa seemed disappointed and shook her head.
["What a… magnificent sword."]
The reason for her disappointment wasn't that Jin's ultimate technique was laughable.
Contrary to what it looked like, Rosa knew that her Meteor Shower was completely blocked by the First Night.
She was disappointed because she couldn't kill Talares with that sword.
Creak!
As soon as Rosa finished speaking, the Meteor Shower seemed to disappear as if it was being absorbed into the First Night.
Blood poured from every hole in Jin's face, and Rosa seemed to be slightly staggered as if she took a hit too.
But that was all. Rosa was about to end Talares with her next sword immediately.
Jin didn't have much strength left now.
Still, Jin threw himself forward.
'With the last remaining strength, if I use the Myungwang Gunlim sword again……!'
What next?
He couldn't think that far. The only thought filling Jin's mind was that he couldn't let Talares die.
At that moment, his emotions completely overruled his rationality.
That's who Talares was to Jin. A comrade, that always meant so much to him.
Kaio also broke the chaotic blades at that exact moment and moved forward with Jin. Talares tried to scream. To not come, to run away and survive.
She had faced Rosa's sword before Jin arrived. That's why she knew that Jin was the only one who could counter Rosa.
If Jin dies here trying to save her, the world would no longer be able to stand against Rosa.
But before Talares could say those words out loud.
Jin realized that he didn't need to risk his life at this moment to save her.
Above Talares' head, a dragon was descending.
Like salvation, a black light was coming down.
["Long time no see, kiddo."]
The Black Dragon Murakan.
He was Jin's guardian dragon.
